campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Field core with moisture over 13 sections
campi_del_mandato.instrument: Closed accumulation chamber 2.4 L for the prisms; core profiles
campi_del_mandato.licence: CC-BY with supplementary (Journal of Hazardous Materials 507:141754)
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: The prism rows carry an internal inconsistency of the source: the measured fluxes sit 29-36% BELOW the production ceiling computed with the paper's own emanation, which free exhalation cannot do. Both the measurement and the paper's own FEM refer to the closed-chamber experiment, where back-diffusion suppresses the net flux.
campi_del_mandato.site: Huelva phosphogypsum stack: closed-chamber prisms (10 and 20 cm) and a field core over 88 cm
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Ra-226 669 Bq/kg, porosity 0.5, saturation 0.4, density 1210 kg/m3, emanation 0.15 (state not declared)
campi_del_mandato.split: Field row: validation. Prism rows: exploratory only, on the internal inconsistency above.
campi_del_mandato.units: Ra-226 Bq/kg; flux mBq/m2/s; depth cm
